query:
The group settled on finger food and light dishes for the street BBQ. How did Marcus respond to this plan, and what does his response reveal about how he actually felt about the format?

Options:
A. Sandra
B. Dev
C. Marcus
D. Yuki
context:
[1] (about=Claire, episodic, t2 @2025-10-19T11:47:00) Marcus, didn't you say once you'd rather have a proper meal than a bunch of nibbles? We could do a proper thing, not just finger food.
[2] (about=Marcus, episodic, t8 @2025-11-16T11:27:00) that's kind Sandra. yeah
[3] (about=Marcus, episodic, t8 @2025-11-16T11:38:00) sounds good. I'll bring wine, something decent
[4] (about=Sandra, episodic, t8 @2025-11-16T11:34:00) Seven o'clock. Just the five of us -- no need to expand it. I will do a roast. Everyone bring something to drink. -- Sandra
[5] (about=Sandra, episodic, t8 @2025-11-16T11:26:00) I will make a proper dinner if you will all come to mine. A real meal, not just a glass and a handful of crisps. Marcus deserves a proper send-off. -- Sandra
[6] (about=Sandra, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T11:32:00) The BBQ, and Marcus's goodbye dinner. Both. I do not want to choose. -- Sandra
[7] (about=Sandra, episodic, t2 @2025-10-19T11:34:00) I would be very happy to contribute a few things from the kitchen. I do think home-made food makes these occasions -- it says something about the street, I think. -- Sandra
[8] (about=Sandra, episodic, t10 @2025-11-23T10:48:00) That sounds about right for Marcus. I'm glad you were there, Dev. -- Sandra
[9] (about=Sandra, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T11:24:00) That does feel like a lot of change in a short time. Marcus goes, Yuki goes for a few weeks, you are partly in Edinburgh. The street changes whether we want it to or not, doesn't it. -- Sandra
[10] (about=Sandra, episodic, t4 @2025-10-26T11:00:00) Just a quick note: I was thinking about what Yuki said last week about keeping things low-key, and I have to agree that is the right approach. We get ourselves into trouble when we over-organise. The summer party last year had a running order and it felt like a work meeting by the end. -- Sandra

query:
